proof_author_and_contributors: Levent Alpöge and the original authors supplied the formalization. The proof retains the Fortytwo fundamental-domain witness and dependent existential elimination from the earlier campaign. MarvinDontPanic generalized the torus identity in public PR 43, crediting Mikko Nyman and collaborators (#103701) and the Fortytwo proofs #103322 and #104025. Jinhyeok Jeong (#106877) supplied the diagonal case split and evaluated the integral on the supplied domain before rescaling the Haar measure. Codex integrated those steps in #107157. In this descendant Codex removed the unused UnitaryBC namespace, let Lean infer the torus-function domain and the measurable-space type, and proved equality of the unipotent maps as functions by extensionality. In #108057’s successor, Codex omitted the binder name in finite-place extensionality, introduced the final constructor arguments as a separate proof goal, and let Lean infer both Haar measures in the absolute continuity calculation. Renxiu Song’s public #107132 rewrites the constant term and its defining integral together. Codex adapted that step to the equality of functions from #108155 by applying extensionality before the rewrite. In the 328-token proof, Codex replaces the previous diagonal case split and finite-place calculation by applying ga_ext and the existing finite projection theorem prodEquiv_diagUnits_posIdele_snd. The resulting proof retains Jeong’s integral argument, Song’s combined rewrite, and MarvinDontPanic’s torus identity. Codex simplified the archimedean diagonal computation and removed the auxiliary equality of unipotent maps by comparing the two Haar integrands in place using congruence and matrix extensionality. Codex unfolded ct and constantTerm to compare the functions directly, and allowed the simplifier to infer the reference Haar measure in the scaling argument. The complete source passed the organizer Comparator and Lean 4.33.1 default kernel on Linux.
